The '''''Oppressor''''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] that served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Darth Angral]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
The ''Oppressor'' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] used by [[Darth Angral]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] while he sent his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] after the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Republic superweapon initiative|super weapons]].

He executed [[Orgus Din]] from the bridge of the cruiser while broadcasting it live on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].

The vessel was eventually destroyed during its attack on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. A [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] boarded the vessel with the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]], sabotaged its energy generators and killed [[Darth Angral]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Sith_warship.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The ''Oppressor''{{'s}} original appearance]]
The ''Oppressor'' first appeared in ''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]'', an issue of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace|''Threat of Peace'']] webcomic that served as a prelude for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. However, as the comic was released in [[2009]], two years before the game itself was released in [[2011]], the ''Oppressor'' looks significantly different than the finalized design for the ''Harrower''-class dreadnought.
